The reporting dashboards refresh every four hours (00:00, 04:00, 08:00, 12:00, 16:00 and 20:00 UTC). This change was made to accommodate business users' request for same-day figures and to remove the need for a single nightly load, which was no longer necessary due to the move to a usage-based warehouse plan. [DEC-0003]

The cost impact of this change was estimated to be under 5% of monthly spend, but this is an estimate and not a measured figure. [DEC-0003]
